entries.text: 高聲也。一曰大呼也。从㗊丩聲。《春秋公羊傳》曰：“魯昭公叫然而哭。”
嘆也。从口旣聲。《詩》曰：“嘅其嘆矣。”
口 mouth + 𦰩# as described in 漢 for the sound alone to simulate a sigh (compare 歎) → *grieve*; *lament* → *mourn*; *deplore*; *regret*.
吞歎也。从口，歎省聲。一曰太息也。
口 mouth + 曹# for the sound alone to simulate noisiness → *noisy*.
As per 加# (place atop) + 壴 as described in 鼓 (round drum set on a stand) → a feast accompanied by music → *good*; *auspicious* → *praise* (← praiseworthy feast).
美也。从壴加聲。
疾也。从口𤐫聲。《詩》曰：“匪車嘌兮。”
口 mouth + 戛# for the sound alone to simulate *cackling* or the *cry/song* of a bird.
As per 叚 (overlay) + 古 here an abbreviated form# of 祜 prosperity; happiness → *prosperity*; *happiness* → *great/large* (← figurative, overlapping layers of prosperity/felicity ).
大遠也。从古叚聲。
口 mouth + 翏# for the sound alone to simulate squawking → *bombast*; *exaggerated speech* → *exaggerate*.
誇語也。从口翏聲。
虖# roar + 口 mouth (for emphasis/clarification) → *roar*; *cry out*.
唬也。从口虖聲。
口 mouth + 彗# for the sound alone to simulate a *soft/quiet voice*.
小聲也。从口彗聲。《詩》曰：“嘒彼小星。”
As per 區# (curve/bend) + 口 mouth → bend and *vomit* → *feel nauseated*. Compare the original sense of 歐.
責# torment + 口 mouth → *torment* orally → *argue*; *noisy*.
大呼也。从口責聲。

As per 尚# (rise → raise) + 旨 tasty → raise delicious food to the mouth and *lick* it → *taste*; *try* → *(have) once (done)*; *experience* → *before*; *formerly*; *ever*; *never* (← have done or not done in the past).
口味之也。从旨尚聲。
口 mouth + 虚# for the sound alone to simulate the sound of a deep *sigh* or slow *exhalation* (compare 嗚). *Brag* and *lie brazenly* (the meanings of the Japanese verb うそぶく) are borrowed meanings.
口 mouth + the traditional form of 麻# for the sound alone to transliterate the second syllable of the Tibetan (b)lama (喇嘛).
口 mouth + 華# for the sound alone to simulate *noise*/*clamor*. Compare 譁.
語聲也。从口然聲。
As per 最# (take a pinch) + 口 mouth → take into the mouth a small amount of food → *eat with the fingers* → *devour*.
嘮呶，讙也。从口勞聲。

As per 肅# (concentrate) + 口 mouth → *howl/roar* (← concentrated noise produced by the mouth). Also, *brag* and *lie brazenly* (the meanings of the Japanese verb うそぶく), in the sense of talking big (← loud voice).
吹聲也。从口肅聲。
小食也。从口幾聲。
口 mouth + 朝# for the sound alone to simulate a sneering noise → *sneer* → *ridicule*. Compare 嗤.
謔也。从口朝聲。《漢書》通用啁。
觜# beak/bill + 口 mouth (for emphasis/clarification) → *beak/bill*; *thin protrusion*.
As per 堯# (arch/rise high) + 口 mouth → *shout/scream* (← high-pitched sound; compare 嘵) → *fear*.
懼也。从口堯聲。《詩》曰：“唯予音之嘵嘵。”
口 mouth + 斯# for the sound alone to simulate neighing/braying → *neigh*; *bray*; *whinny*.
口 mouth + 皐# variant form of 皋 for the sound alone to simulate the howling or roaring of wild beasts → *howl*; *roar*; *wail*; *cry*.
As per 無# (concealed) + 口 mouth → conceal one's thoughts by remaining silent → phrase used to indicate conjecture (*I suppose/imagine*; *I dare say*; *No doubt*; *Indeed*).
尞 as described in 僚 here an abbreviated form# of 瞭 clarity + 口 mouth → (indirect reference to) *clarity or resonance of voice*. Compare 喨.

As per 喜# (emit a joyful voice) + 口 mouth → emit a *joyful voice* → *laugh*. *Interjection* (of lamentation) is a borrowed meaning. 嘻 was devised to replace 喜 after 喜 came to refer to joy and pleasure in general as opposed to joyful voices.
㹌也。象耳、頭、足厹地之形。古文嘼，下从厹。凡嘼之屬皆从嘼。
As per 單# (fanning motion) + 口 mouth → *gasp*; *pant* (rapid inhaling and exhaling ← fanning motion). *Stretch flat* and *peaceful* are borrowed meanings (compare 坦).
喘息也。一曰喜也。从口單聲。《詩》曰：“嘽嘽駱馬。”
含深也。从口覃聲。
口 mouth + 巽# for the sound alone to simulate the sound of liquid being expelled from the mouth → *spit liquid*.

entries.text: 口 mouth + 尊# for the sound alone to simulate conversational hubbub → *converse noisily*; *swap stories*; *meet*; *gossip* → *rumor*.
聚語也。从口尊聲。《詩》曰：“噂沓背憎。”
嗛也。从口朁聲。
As per 敢# (covered) + 口 mouth → food contained in the mouth in biting/chewing → *bite*; *chew*; *eat*.
危也。从口矞聲。
口 mouth + the present form of 曾# for the sound alone to simulate a hissing noise → *noisy*.
As per 焦# (shrink) + 口 mouth → *chew* food, reducing it to edible proportions.
齧也。从口焦聲。
As per 壹# (crammed full) + 口 mouth → *choke* (compare 旡) on a mouthful of food.
飯窒也。从口壹聲。
As per 翕# (press) + 口 mouth → *compress* the lips in sucking in breath (compare 吸, 哈 and 歙) → *inhale* → *absorb*.
吹也。从口虛聲。
噞喁，魚口上見也。从口僉聲。
喙也。从口蜀聲。
As per 禁# (contain) + 口 mouth → mumbled voice/sound contained in the mouth (compare 吟 and 唸)→ *shut one's mouth* (compare 箝) → *shut*.
口閉也。从口禁聲。
口 mouth + 歳# for the sound alone to simulate a *belch*; *hiccup*. Compare 噫.
气啎也。从口歲聲。
高气多言也。从口，蠆省聲。《春秋傳》曰：“噧言。”

An element# quadrupling 口 mouth/hole (→ variety of containers) + 犬 dog/beast → vessels filled with hunted game, or meat (compare 獻). The idea is to reduce the empty space in a *container/receptacle* by filling it (compare 吉) → *vessel*; *implement*. Also, *ability* (← have capacity/capability).
皿也。象器之口，犬所以守之。
As per 喿# as described in 操 (noisy chirping) + 口 mouth → *noisy* chirping of birds (or other chatter).
口 mouth + 意# for the sound alone to simulate a *belch* or *burp*. Compare 噦.
飽食息也。从口意聲。
口 mouth + 筮# for the sound alone to simulate the sound of snapping → *snap at*; *bite* → *eat*.
啗也。喙也。从口筮聲。
吼也。从口敫聲。一曰噭，呼也。
口 mouth + 愛# for the sound alone to simulate a belching noise → *belch*. Also, *breathe*.
大笑也。从口豦聲。
As per 會# (reduce/eliminate space) + 口 mouth → *swallow*/*gulp* down (a lump of) food → *eat* → *throat* (down which food is swallowed).
咽也。从口會聲。讀若快。一曰嚵，噲也。
麋鹿羣口相聚皃。从口虞聲。《詩》曰：“麀鹿噳噳。”
As per 賁# (swell) + 口 mouth → outpouring of objects spewing from the mouth → *spew*; *spout*; *emit*. *Gush* and *boil over* are borrowed meanings.
吒也。从口賁聲。一曰鼓鼻。
口 mouth + 頓 for the sound to transliterate the English *ton*.

entries.text: 新 new + 口 mouth → (new/unusual) *story*; *talk*.
As per 寧# (settle) + 口 mouth → speak words that settle a matter → *considerate*; *kindness*.
口 mouth + an abbreviated form# of 矍 for the sound alone to simulate a *roar*.
口 mouth + 需# for the sound alone to simulate *mumbling/indistinct speech*.
口 mouth + 蒿# for the sound alone to simulate a particular noise (possibly, that made by a whistling arrow; compare 嘵) → *make noise* → *call* (out).
As per 赫# (threaten) + 口 mouth → *threaten* as though brilliant flames were being emitted from the mouth. 嚇 was devised to replace 赫.
口 mouth + 鼻# for the sound alone to simulate panting or *breathing heavily through the nose*. Casual/slighting reference to *one's wife* is a borrowed meaning.
嘗也。从口齊聲。《周書》曰：“大保受同祭嚌。”
悟解气也。从口疐聲。《詩》曰：“願言則嚏。”
語未定皃。从口憂聲。
齒 teeth + 口# mouth → *bite*; *chew* (← cross the teeth in biting/chewing). Compare 咬 and 齩.
臣# subject; retainer + 口 mouth/hole (quadrupled to indicate a number of mouths) → *noisy conversation* among persons of low rank → *noisy*; *foolish*.
語聲也。从㗊臣聲。
食辛嚛也。从口樂聲。
燕# swallow + 口 mouth + *swallow*/*gulp* in the manner of the (avian) swallow, a voracious consumer of insects. Compare 咽.
As per 龍# (winding) + 口 mouth → a bent *throat* (as opposed to a straight one).
喉也。从口龍聲。
As per 頻# (no interval) + 口 mouth → lips tightly pursed into a *frown* → *scowl*. Compare 顰.
As per 否# (spread/bulge) + 喜 (a feast) → *large*/bulging spread of food (compare 餔)→ *plump*.
大也。从喜否聲。《春秋傳》：“吳有太宰嚭。”
鄕 here a variant form of 卿# (be positioned at opposite sides) + 向 advance upon → *head off/out* or *guide* another to a distant destination. *Be (in the) past* is a borrowed meaning via 曏.
As per 𦥯# as described in 學 (obtain knowledge) + 告 inform → *inform*, enabling knowledge to be obtained. Also, and likely on account of the same imagery, the *name of a legendary Chinese emperor*.
急告之甚也。从告，學省聲。
Abbreviated and variant form of 嵒 cliff + 敢# (covered) → rugged geologic feature such as a cliff covering the side of a hill/mountain → *severity*; *strictness* (← rugged) → *solemnity*.
教命急也。从吅𠪚聲。
小𠻜也。从口毚聲。一曰喙也。
口 mouth + 嬰# for the sound alone to simulate the *chirping* of a bird. Compare 哢, 啅 and 囀.
鳥鳴也。从口嬰聲。
As per 爵# (small) + 口 mouth → *chew* food into small pieces. Compare 齪.
口 mouth + 雚# as described in 勸 for the sound alone to simulate a calling noise → *call*; *call out*; *make a stir*.
口 mouth + 轉# for the sound alone to simulate the *chirping* (compare 哢, 啅 and 嚶), *twittering* or *warbling* of a bird.
聶# whisper + 口 mouth → (figuratively or actually) press one's mouth to another person's ear in whispering → *whisper*; *murmur*.
聲也。气出頭上。从㗊从頁。頁，首也。
雜# miscellaneous + 口 mouth → miscellaneous voices → *jeer*; *banter*. Also, *accompany* and *musical accompaniment* (← loud accompanying voices).
口 mouth + 藝# for the sound alone to simulate babbling → *foolish words*.

As per 襄# (sack) + a variant of the element that came to be written 東 (sack bound on two ends and pierced by a shaft) → *sack*; *bag*; *pouch* → *container*. 囊 was devised to replace 襄 after 襄 lost its connection with "sack."
橐也。从㯻省，襄省聲。

囌.explanation: Specialized alternate character in certain older and regional written forms, particularly speech/onomatopoeic or revival-related words; not the general glyph for Su surnames or the plant name.
囌.usageCaveat: No directly validated OpenCC phrase example for 囌 was found in this review; require a lexicon entry before showing a concrete example.
囌.evidenceScope: Unihan 17.0 forward relationship; lexical use and 2013 official classification not independently exhaustively checked.

蘇.explanation: Common traditional form in many uses, including the phonetic name “Su” and other ordinary lexemes; not interchangeable with 囌 in all specialized contexts.
蘇.evidenceScope: OpenCC 1.4.2 explicitly maps 苏打→蘇打. Other senses require individual lexical check.

sources.basis: Lexical example explicitly found in OpenCC 1.4.2 STPhrases

entries.text: 屬# adhere + 口 mouth → lips adhering to another person's ear in whispering a *request* → *entrust to*.

A depiction of a circular *enclosure* such as a city wall → *specific/particular place*. Although the present style of the character squares the edges, ancient forms are rounded, and the association with circularity is evidenced by cognate characters with the element such as 韋, 圍 and 囮.
回也。象回帀之形。凡囗之屬皆从囗。
囗 here an abbreviated form# of 周 (an enclosure) + 人 person → *prisoner* confined in an enclosure.
繫也。从人在囗中。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is four horizontal lines indicating *four* → *fourth*; *four times*. The present form derives from SIS, which is 口 mouth + 八 split right and left → splitting off/dispersal of breath through the nostrils to right and left (compare 自). Earlier, a bronzeware inscription form combined 口 with the horizontal lines of the oracle bone form (repositioned) to suggest the same idea of dispersal of breath. In that sense, the application of the meaning "four" to the present character represents a borrowed meaning.
陰𢿙也。象四分之形。凡四之屬皆从四。

A depiction of one object rotating within another → *rotate*; *revolve*; *spin*; *turn/go around* → *pass around*; *spread* (of a fire); (of medicine/alcohol) *take effect*; *number of times*; *encircle*; *curve*; *return*; *detour*; *cycle*. Extended meanings include *refer to* (a specialist) and *transfer* (← pass around), as well as *sumo wrestler's belt* (← encircling object). 回 may be regarded as a variant of the cognate 冎/咼 (bone circulating in its joint).
轉也。从囗，中象回轉形。
頭會，匘蓋也。象形。凡囟之屬皆从囟。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows bedding upon which a person lies/adheres (that is, over which the person is superimposed) → *depend*; *cause*; *be connected with* (← superimposition) → *be based on*; *be due to*; *therefore*; *consequently*.
就也。从囗、大。

團.explanation: Group, association, reunion sense: use 團 rather than the food term 糰.
團.evidenceScope: 2013 appendix and OpenCC 1.4.2 phrase example; meaning is not interchangeable with food-ball sense.

sources.basis: Lexical example explicitly found in OpenCC 1.4.2 STPhrases

糰.explanation: Round food mass or dumpling sense, rather than an organization or group.

entries.text: 窻牖麗廔闓明。象形。凡囧之屬皆从囧。讀若獷。賈侍中說：讀與明同。
回也。从囗云聲。
在牆曰牖，在屋曰囪。象形。凡囪之屬皆从囪。
化# deceive + 囗 circular enclosure → caged *decoy* → *lure*.
譯也。从囗、化。率鳥者繫生鳥以來之，名曰囮。讀若譌。又音由。
囗# circular enclosure + 木 tree/wood → bale of wood tightly encircled in being bound by a cord → *distress*; *difficulty*; *trouble* → *be at a loss*.
故廬也。从木在囗中。
禾 grain/rice + 囗# circular enclosure → bundle grain and place in a *granary* → *surround* in a circular manner.
廩之圜者。从禾在囗中。圜謂之囷，方謂之京。
As per 令# (long sequence) + 囗 circular enclosure → *enclosure with latticed windows* (compare 櫺) → *jail*; *prison*.
獄也。从囗令聲。

古# hard; dried out + 囗 circular enclosure → harden about an object → *hard/harden*; *stiff/stiffen* → *resolute*; *stubborn*. Other extended meanings include *tight*, *firm*, *rigid*, *strict*, *solid*, *jell*, *fortify*, *collect*, *settle*, and *settle down*.
四塞也。从囗古聲。
As per 有# (extend) + 囗 circular enclosure → (enclosed, extensive) *game preserve* → *garden*. Also, *constrained* (in outlook; ← contained; constrained ← contained preserve).
苑有垣也。从囗有聲。一曰禽獸曰囿。
